name: Lucky x Crosse
source:
A beautiful port town, Kitadate town, where the ocean can be seen from the top of its hill. It was almost July, and a late summer was about to arrive in this northern town.

The main character, Keito Kitami, was a freshman at Kitamizora Highschool in Kitade town. Kitamizora Highschool was a renowened school with a dorm. Since it used to be an all girl’s school, there isn’t that many boys and Keito lived in the girl’s dorm as well.

Since Keito had interest in Lacrosse from the beginning, he joins the Kimizora Highschool Lacrosse club. But he ends up being as the only guy in there. To Keito’s disappointment, what all the extraordinary girls in the club do is just fool around without competing seriously.

While being pushed around by the girls in the club, Keito meets a girl called Fuuka Asahikawa, and somehow falls in love with her.

A Lacrosse club that only consists of six members and can’t even play a real game.
Keito and the girl’s first summer was about to begin…

[From [url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=528]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
translation:
北馆町是一座美丽的港口城市，从山丘顶端便能望见大海。时近七月，这座北方小城姗姗来迟的夏季即将到来。

主人公北见圭人是北馆町北见空高中的一年级学生。北见空高中是一所有名的寄宿制学校，前身是女校，因此男生不多，圭人也住在女生宿舍。

圭人原本就对长曲棍球感兴趣，于是加入了北见空高中的长曲棍球社，结果却成了社团里唯一的男生。令他失望的是，社团里的女孩个个与众不同，却只顾玩闹，完全不认真比赛。

圭人被社团里的女孩们耍得团团转，同时结识了一名叫朝日川风香的少女，并不知不觉爱上了她。

长曲棍球社只有六名成员，甚至无法进行一场正式比赛。
圭人与少女们的第一个夏天即将开始……

[摘自[url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=528]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
